title: Surcharge Annex to the Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment Delivery Tariff
content:
This annex states the distance and site figures each fulfilment service of Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment
carries. For each service: the served radius is the miles from the fulfilment point served without a surcharge; the
out of radius surcharge is the amount for delivering beyond that served radius; the stairs surcharge is the amount
for each flight of stairs above the first; the crew column states whether two people attend the delivery; and the
access column states what must be clear for the crew to deliver.

| Fulfilment service | Served radius, miles | Out of radius surcharge | Stairs surcharge, each flight above the first | Two people attend | What must be clear for the crew |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | no | a safe place to leave the parcel |
| Store Pickup Hold | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | no | photographic identity and the order reference |
| Threshold Delivery | 40 | 75.00 | 25.00 | yes | a clear path to the threshold |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | 40 | 95.00 | 35.00 | yes | a clear path to the room and the room cleared |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | 60 | 145.00 | 45.00 | yes | a clear path, the room cleared and mains services accessible |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | 120 | 250.00 | 60.00 | yes | a booked dock with pallet access |

## Worked figures on hypothetical addresses

An address 52 miles from the fulfilment point lies inside the 60 mile served radius of White Glove Delivery and
Installation and beyond the 40 mile served radius of Threshold Delivery. On the first service no out of radius
surcharge attaches to that address; on the second the out of radius surcharge attaching to it is 75.00. The figure
of 145.00 is the out of radius figure of White Glove Delivery and Installation and attaches only to an address lying
beyond that service's own 60 mile radius.

An address reached by three flights of stairs has two flights above the first. On Room of Choice Delivery with Haul
Away the stairs figure of 35.00 for each flight above the first gives 70.00 in total for that address; on White
Glove Delivery and Installation the same three flights give 90.00.

## Notes on the two nil services

Standard Parcel Delivery and Store Pickup Hold carry a served radius of 0 miles and nil figures for both the out of
radius surcharge and the stairs surcharge; the parcel service is stated to need a safe place to leave the parcel and
the collection service to need photographic identity and the order reference.
